title: Fragility of Minimum-Variance Portfolios
summary: Minimum-variance portfolios are well known to be highly sensitive to covariance estimation error. In this paper, we show that by imposing a block diagonal correlation structure, we can derive closed-form expressions for long-only minimum-variance portfolios that make this fragility explicit. These analytical solutions reveal that fragility is driven by threshold effects arising from the interaction between correlation structure and the assets' volatilities.
